title: Turkish-Style Lamb Kofte with German Flair
description: A flavorful twist on traditional Turkish kofte, featuring German-inspired spices and a side of tangy mustard.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb, onion, parsley, allspice, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well with your hands until just combined. Do not overmix.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small kofte, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Thread the kofte onto skewers, leaving a little space between each one.
Grill the kofte for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through to an internal temperature of 160°F.
Transfer the kofte to a plate and serve with German mustard on the side.
Serve hot with a side of warm pita bread or a salad, if desired.
